## Workload

Priya Anand completed 248 reads during the quarter, recording 396 hours of work. This represents a rate of 0.6 reads per hour. The workload record provides a clear account of the reading activity completed and the time associated with it. The figures indicate that the review work was undertaken across the recorded hours rather than being reported solely as a volume of completed reads.

## Quality

A total of 18 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 83.3. This provides the recorded measure of consistency for the checked sample. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support review of those cases and inform subsequent work. The review was completed by Priya Anand, who was also the grader.
